# Select and charter the Slice 1 Anth.us story

## Purpose

Choose the real editorial work before implementation choices harden around a dummy fixture.

## Deliverables

- Identify one genuine unpublished Anth.us story with enough research and editorial judgment to exercise the workflow.
- Record the editor, agent responsibilities, intended CMS destination, publication expectations, and acceptable source handling.
- Confirm that the story is suitable for the single-author, low-confidentiality Slice 1 environment.
- Record which limitations prevent this story from representing other pre-infrastructure publications.
- Define the final handoff fields and media expectations needed by this specific post without promoting them into generic Kanbus features.

## Verification

The selected story has an explicit owner and publication target, is not a dummy fixture, and can proceed without introducing hosted infrastructure or confidential material.
